description: Replacement of a ground floor side extension with a side - return extension. Alterations including excavation to enlarge basement with formation of front light well. New rear dormer and two conservation-rooflights to the front roof slope.
decision_conditions: <p><span id="docs-internal-guid-b83e066f-7fff-c64b-f609-becabc837e74"><span style="font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline;">By reason of its inappropriate size, scale, and materials, the proposed wrap-around extension, rear dormer and front lightwell would result in an obtrusive and incongruous development that would detract from the architectural integrity of the existing building as well as the wider row of terraced properties of which the application site forms part. As such, the proposal would fail to preserve or enhance the character and appearance of the Graham Road and Mapledene Conservation Area. This identified less than substantial harm would not be outweighed by any public benefits. The proposed development would, therefore, conflict with policies D3 (Optimising site layout through the design-led approach), D4 (Delivering good design), and HC1 (Heritage conservation and growth) of the London Plan (2021) and policies LP1 (Design Quality and Local Character) and LP3 (Designated Heritage Assets) of the Hackney Local Plan 2033 (2020) and the advice in Hackney's Residential Extensions and Alterations SPD (2025). </span></span></p>

<p><span id="docs-internal-guid-4a484d37-7fff-f347-733f-d42f94e36a2d"><span style="font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline;">The proposed development, by reason of its size, siting and design would appear unduly overbearing, result in an unacceptable perceived sense of enclosure, and result in undue loss of privacy, detrimental to the residential amenity of neighbouring occupiers, contrary to Policy D4 of the London Plan and Policies LP1 and LP2 of the Hackney Local Plan 2033.</span></span></p>

<p><span id="docs-internal-guid-e407a082-7fff-4808-5d12-33228fa92b52"><span style="font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline;">Insufficient arboricultural information has been provided to allow for an assessment of the impacts of the proposal on the trees present on the site and adjoining land. Therefore, the application has not satisfactorily demonstrated that the application will not cause harm to trees in a conservation area to the detriment of the visual amenities of the site, contrary to policies LP46 (Protection and Enhancement of Green Infrastructure), LP47 (Biodiversity and Sites of Importance of Nature Conservation), and LP51 (Tree Management and Landscaping) of the Hackney Local Plan (2020) and policies G1 (Green infrastructure), G6 (Biodiversity and access to nature), and G7 (Trees and woodlands) of the London Plan (2021). </span></span></p>
